frontMatter.title: Wednesday Club Night
frontMatter.summary: Celebrate National Hugging Day at Wednesday Club Night—Grade 2 Ladies cup match (Navan 'A' v Ardee), two courts free from 8pm, and league-only action for juveniles.

prev.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont
prev.summary: Two home matches at Claremont—Navan 'A' vs Kildalkey (Grade 2 Mixed) and Navan vs Drumree (Grade 7 Mens) — plus member courts from 9pm and Juvenile Club Night from 6:30pm.

next.title: No Club Night Tonight: Three Matches, One Packed Schedule
next.summary: No club night for members tonight as the courts are fully booked with three matches: Grade 3 Mens (Navan vs Ardee B) and two Grade 5 Mens ties (Navan vs Bailieboro, Navan B vs Ardee B).
